_about: One subject per image call. A dog's prompt is pre.txt + dog.txt with {BREED}, {TAIL_TROT} and {TAIL_SLEEP} filled from here + post.txt + 'Landscape 3:2.'; the first crew's was pre.txt + crew.txt (or crew2.txt) + post.txt + 'Landscape 3:2.'; the faceted crew's (G5d round 2) is pre-facets.txt + crew-facets.txt, crew-facets-2.txt, crew2-facets.txt or crew2-facets-2.txt + post.txt + 'Landscape 3:2.'. make_prompt.py writes the exact text sent. The Lab's paragraph is the one its shipping call (cast-lab-3) used; the two rejected Lab calls' texts are verbatim in docs/art-provenance/cast/README.md.

golden.breed: golden retriever, the same breed and finish as the goldens in key.png (a medium warm golden coat, not orange and not cream, soft drop ears, a dark nose, feathering on the chest, the backs of the legs and a long tail)
golden.tail_trot: , the feathered tail carried level out behind
golden.tail_sleep: , the feathered tail curled along its body

corgi.breed: Pembroke Welsh corgi, the same breed and finish as the corgis in key.png (red and white: a warm orange-tan back, head and ears, a white chest, a white muzzle and blaze, white legs and paws; a long low body on short legs, large upright pointed ears, a short docked stub tail), with an adult head in proportion to its body, not oversized

collie.breed: border collie, the same breed and finish as the black-and-white collie in key.png (a black body, head and ears, a white blaze down the middle of the face, a white muzzle, a white ruff round the neck and chest, white legs and paws, a white tail tip; ears half up with the tips folded forward; a medium-length coat; a lean athletic body)
collie.tail_trot: , the long feathered tail carried low behind
collie.tail_sleep: , the long tail wrapped round its body

beagle.breed: beagle, the same breed and finish as the beagle in key.png (tricolour: a black saddle over the back, a tan head, tan ears and tan sides, a white muzzle, a white chest, white legs and paws and a white tail tip; long soft drop ears; a sturdy compact body on straight legs)
beagle.tail_trot: , the tail carried up with its white tip

poodle.breed: standard poodle (a large poodle, not a toy), the same breed and finish as the brown poodle in key.png (a medium chocolate-brown curly coat in a lamb clip: the same short length all over the body and legs, a rounded topknot on the head, long curly drop ears, a narrow muzzle, a straight tail carried up with a round pom-pom at its tip; long legs and an elegant square build)

lab.breed: Labrador retriever, a black Lab, in the same finish as the dogs in key.png but NOT a golden retriever: a sleek, smooth, short black coat that lies flat, with no feathering or long hair anywhere (none on the tail, the legs, the chest or the ears); a broad blocky head with a clear stop, a wide muzzle and short drop ears; a thick otter tail: wide at the base, short-haired, smooth and rounded, tapering to a point like a rudder, never fluffy or plumed; a sturdy, deep-chested, athletic build. The black coat still shows its flat triangular facets in dark charcoal greys, lit from the upper left as in key.png
lab.tail_trot: , the smooth otter tail carried level out behind
lab.tail_sleep: , the smooth otter tail lying along its body

labyellow.breed: Labrador retriever, a yellow Lab: the same dog as in labref.png (load it from the current working directory with view_image too; keep its blocky head, its smooth short coat with no feathering, its thick smooth otter tail, its build and its three poses) but with a pale cream-yellow coat instead of a black one, a black nose and dark brown eyes; NOT a golden retriever: no feathering anywhere, no plumed or fluffy tail
labyellow.tail_trot: , the smooth otter tail carried level out behind
labyellow.tail_sleep: , the smooth otter tail lying along its body
